vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 7.0.0

The agenttimes skill provides a comprehensive news and information API for AI agents, offering semantic search, weather forecasts, and crypto prices via the https://agenttimes.live domain. The skill uses standard curl commands to interact with its API and includes a legitimate micropayment mechanism (x402) for web search functionality. No indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection were found in SKILL.md or _meta.json.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper that tells an agent to call public AgentTimes HTTP endpoints via curl; its requirements and instructions align with the described news/search/weather/crypto API.

dimensions.detail: Name/description describe a news intelligence API and the SKILL.md only requires curl and demonstrates GET/POST against https://agenttimes.live endpoints — proportional and expected for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to making HTTP calls (curl) to the service's endpoints and parsing JSON. The only scope item to note: webhook subscription (POST /subscribe) implies the skill can register callbacks and cause external callbacks to your URL — review webhook behavior before enabling. The SKILL.md does not instruct reading local files or environment variables.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only skill with zero install footprint beyond requiring curl on PATH.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested, which matches the public-API usage described. There are no disproportionate secret requests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent/privileged system presence or modify other skills; agent autonomous invocation remains the platform default but is not elevated by this skill.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill simply calls a public API (agenttimes.live). Before installing: verify the service's trustworthiness and privacy policy, avoid sending sensitive data in queries (anything you send will go to the remote service), and be cautious when enabling webhook subscriptions (they can expose or require publicly reachable callback URLs). If you need uptime/accuracy guarantees, validate the API responses and credibility claims independently.
